title: The text describes a lawyer, Mr. Chuks Anayo, who has high praise for a former Lagos State Police Commissioner, Alhaji Abubakar Tsav, for his dedication and efforts to combat corruption within the police force. The text also mentions a scientific breakthrough in the field of reproductive medicine, where scientists have found a way to use genetic material from an infertile woman and inject it into a donor egg from a fertile woman to produce a baby with two genetic mothers. The method is described as "profoundly disturbing" by some medical ethicists, but is not human cloning.
